# Isaac Seiler — Tech Generalist

> Isaac Seiler is a Seattle-based tech generalist with experience across AI, public policy, education, research, journalism, and communications. He leads marketing and communications at Summation and has worked across government, enterprise, and international education.

Canonical website: https://seiler.page/

## Projects
- [Leading AI Literacy Efforts in Taiwan](https://seiler.page/projects/fulbright-focus-group-sponsored-by-openai.md): Isaac Seiler pitched and led one of the first Local ChatGPT Labs, then turned what educators learned into a published resource and conference workshop.
- [Mapping the Rise of AI Across State Government](https://seiler.page/projects/artificial-intelligence-in-state-government-index.md): Isaac Seiler's August 2025 benchmark of generative AI adoption, training, governance, and preparedness across U.S. states and territories.
- [Investigating AI’s Impact on Journalism in Australia](https://seiler.page/projects/senior-thesis-local-journalism.md): Isaac Seiler's honors thesis analyzed AI, digital platforms, local journalism, democratic accountability, media policy, and newsroom labor through qualitative interviews.
- [Building a Congressional Operation from Scratch](https://seiler.page/projects/congressional-office-setup-100-day-report.md): Isaac Seiler helped launch a congressional office and built a press network spanning West Michigan, statewide, and national media.
- [Bringing the Boehringer Cares Rebrand to Life](https://seiler.page/projects/boehringer-cares-foundation-rebrand-strategy-shift.md): Implementing the Boehringer Cares rebrand across its website, employee communications, newsletter, and volunteering programs.
- [Raised $20k for Local St. Louis Organizations](https://seiler.page/projects/stl-immigrant-refugee-support-grant-process.md): A student-led philanthropy process by Isaac Seiler's WashU team evaluating and supporting St. Louis immigrant and refugee-serving nonprofits.
- [Helping Shape OpenAI's Products Before Launch](https://seiler.page/projects/openai-product-testing-and-feedback.md): Inside my work with OpenAI's first ChatGPT Lab: testing products before release, pressure-testing student use cases, contributing to launch campaigns, and turning 100 real workflows into a published book.

## Attribution
The government AI benchmark is an August 2025 snapshot. OpenAI program participation, collaboration, and product feedback are distinct from employment. Project pages link to published evidence.
